name: How we built a component library that people actually enjoy using
summary: Case study of how Sprout Social built its Seeds React component library: docs, author tooling and the details users see.
description: Chase McCoy's walkthrough of Sprout Social's Seeds design system library: separating library development from documentation, empowering component authors, and the consumer-facing touches that made people enjoy using it — interactive code blocks, token tags, a typography playground and system props.
contains: walkthrough of Sprout Social's Seeds design system
consumer features: interactive code blocks, token tags, typography playground, system props
